newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Profits soar 22 pct at Belgian retailer Delhaize.
newsitem.headline: Profits soar 22 pct at Belgian retailer Delhaize.

text.p: Leading Belgian retail group Ets Delhaize Freres et Cie "Le Lion" SA said on Friday first half 1996 group net profit rose 22 percent, and it expected a large rise in full year earnings compared to last year.

Unless there were unfavourable currency fluctuations, Delhaize forecast a "significant increase" in consolidated results for full year 1996. Delhaize is especially exposed to the dollar because of its U.S. unit Food Lion.
"However the growth rate could be not as strong as the one achieved at the end of the first half of 1996, taking into account the good results of the second half of 1995," it added in a statement.
Delhaize's first half 1996 group net profit rose 22 percent to 1.974 billion Belgian francs ($64.05 million).
Consolidated turnover rose 11 percent to 191 billion francs.
The retailer had a full year 1995 turnover of 368 billion francs. ($1=30.82 Belgian Franc)
